title: How Post-Training Influences Verbalized Algorithmic Computation in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.13552v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Post-training improves language-model reasoning, but how it changes the use of internal information and verbalized chain of thought (CoT) remains unclear. We study successive SFT, DPO, and RLVR checkpoints of Olmo-3-7B-Instruct on multi-digit addition, using carry values as known intermediate state. Probes recover carry information from internal activations with similar accuracy in SFT and RLVR, although manipulating this information does not reliably control model outputs. In contrast, the usefulness of verbalized reasoning differs: CoTs produced by RLVR yield higher accuracy across receiving checkpoints than those produced by SFT or DPO. We also show that carry-related statements receive higher importance scores after RLVR than matched random controls. translated_title: 后训练如何影响语言模型中的言语化算法计算
translated_abstract: 后训练提升了语言模型的推理能力，但它如何改变内部信息的使用以及言语化思维链（CoT）的作用仍不清楚。我们研究了 Olmo-3-7B-Instruct 在多位数加法任务上经过 SFT、DPO 和 RLVR 相继训练后的各个检查点，并将进位值作为已知的中间状态。探测方法在 SFT 和 RLVR 模型中都能以相似的准确率从内部激活中恢复进位信息，尽管操纵这些信息并不能可靠地控制模型输出。相比之下，言语化推理的有用性存在差异：RLVR 产生的思维链相比 SFT 或 DPO 产生的思维链，在各接收检查点上带来更高的准确率。我们还发现，RLVR 之后与进位相关的陈述比匹配的随机对照获得更高的重要性分数。DPO 对进位相关陈述表现出类似的敏感性，但没有相应的准确率提升。这些结果表明，后训练改变了书面推理的有用性……
tldr: 后训练主要改变的是言语化推理的有用性而非内部信息的编码方式——SFT 和 RLVR 后的模型内部均可读取进位信息，但 RLVR 产生的思维链在各检查点上显著提升了推理准确率。
en_tdlr: Post-training changes the usefulness of verbalized reasoning rather than the internal encoding of intermediate information: carry values are recoverable with similar accuracy from both SFT and RLVR models, but CoTs generated by RLVR-trained models yield higher accuracy across receiving checkpoints.
